header.text: Experience review queue, reports, manual badges and hidden posts.

forbidden.title: Restricted
forbidden.text: This page is for the Moddy team. This account does not have access.

help.title: Review rules
help.order: The oldest requests are at the top.
help.verify: Verify keeps the existing proof and adds your note.
help.reject: Reject needs a reason, which the person can read.

verify.title: Verify this experience
verify.text: The experience becomes verified, staff method. The existing proof is kept.

reject.title: Reject this experience
reject.text: The person will see this reason and can ask for a new review after fixing it.

help.title: Before you decide
help.target: Open the target first. Resolving or dismissing does not change the target: hide the post separately.
help.once: A decided report cannot be decided again.

resolve.title: Mark as resolved
resolve.text: The report is closed with action taken. The target is not changed.

dismiss.title: Dismiss without action
dismiss.text: The report is closed with no action. It cannot be reopened.

empty.title: No manual badges
empty.text: No badge has been granted for this filter.

revoke.title: Revoke this badge
revoke.text: The badge leaves the profile right away. You can grant it again.

form.title: Grant a badge
form.text: Only the manual badges of the catalog are offered, depending on the entity type.
form.entityIdHint: 15 to 20 digits. The entity is not checked to exist.
form.notForEntity: This badge does not exist for this entity type.
form.serverOnly: Some badges are for servers only.

lookup.label: Post id or link
lookup.hint: Paste the UUID or the address of the post.

empty.title: No post selected
empty.text: Paste an id or a link to see its status and hide it.

help.title: Hiding
help.hide: Hiding removes the post from every public read. The author sees the reason and can no longer edit or delete it.
help.unhide: Unhiding sets it to closed, never to published. The author must publish it again.

hide.title: Hide this post
hide.text: The post leaves the public lists. The author reads the reason.

unhide.title: Unhide this post
unhide.text: The post becomes closed. The author must publish it again for it to be visible.
